# Lower Mill Windmill

## Sails

The Lower Mill is set to four cloths on each stock when the wind is below 25 knots by the flag. A fifth cloth is added in a steady breeze.

## Stone dressing

The Lower Mill runner stone is dressed every 8 days of grinding with the mill bill. The face is tested with the paint staff.

## Toll

The Lower Mill miller takes one twelfth of the grain as toll.
